title: Children Birthday Party, Whittier CA Cake - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
MAXWELL C. PELL
PHOTO SERVICE
SEP 5 1936
WHITTIER, CALIF.
description: Six children gather outdoors around a checkered-cloth table to celebrate a toddler's birthday under a shaded canopy of trees. A frosted cake with a candle and wrapped gifts sit on the table as the older siblings look on attentively. Two young girls wear knitted handmade halter-style swimwear popular in the mid-1930s, while the boys wear casual summer shirts and trousers. Captured in Whittier, California, during the late Great Depression, this snapshot reflects everyday family leisure and milestone celebrations.
